notes.title: Card changes and new Ranked mode!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We continue to work on ManaRocks to improve the game and your experience.

In addition to the balance changes of some cards below, we are going to make a more drastic change in ranked mode.

Ranked matches will become 1v1. Therefore, we will create a list of the top 20 players at the end of July and on July 31 we will change the ranked mode.

The tiers will not be modified, you will keep it and continue to earn tier points normally until the end of the season.

2v2 mode will be implemented as Casual mode and will continue in Practice.

Now, let's see the changes in the cards that will happen on July 23th:

• Now the 'Shaman's Relic' artifact has decreased from 3 to just 2 charges.

• The 'Shattering Wave' sorcery now in addition to destroying all mana, it will not leave all players with 0 mana, but with 1 mana.

• 'Exiled Dwarf' now when joined with another card with the 'Alliance' ability will increase the cards' cost by +2 until the next turn and he is now a 4/4 creature.

• 'Dwarven Warmachine' now when joined with another card with the 'Alliance' ability  will deal 1 damage to 3 random enemy creatures.

• 'Freeze Land' now costs 4 mana.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31411040/99900639d7bd844676c37748ffc37efd5e5d7bdc.jpg[/img]

Share your thoughts at our Discord:

https://discord.gg/T5eCRSw

Play now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/762560/ManaRocks/

See you playing!
ManaRocks Team

notes.title: New Season is Online!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Our Pre Release Season is online and ready to play!

As you may know, this season is a test to improve our game and then lauch it.

That's why we need you! To make sure this new version is fun and balanced, we are calling all our players to play and help us test and prepare the game for release.

For this Season we have removed the Stamina's mechanic and change some combat rules:

- Creatures do not have to wait a turn to attack. (Rush ceases to exist);
- after attacking, creatures will go to backline (it was already like this);
- creatures that are on backline or sneaked deal no damage in combat.

With that, we had to review the balance and changed almost half of the cards! 

Please share your thoughts on our Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/T5eCRSw]https://discord.gg/T5eCRSw[/url]

Play it now on:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/762560/ManaRocks/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/762560/ManaRocks/[/url]

Thanks, see you playing ManaRocks!
ManaRocks Team

notes.title: ManaRocks' New Version is Online
notes.content:
Hello!

We are very happy to announce that the new ManaRocks' update is online.

There are some major changes to the core of the game. Just to remember them:

- Focus on 2v2: All ranked games will be 2v2; Both players on team will play at the same time; Both enemy heroes must be destroyed to win the match.
- New Creature's mechanic: Stamina, creatures will spend Stamina to Attack and Block.
- Hero Powers will evolve as you play cards from their colors.

Besides that there are some minor changes, as card balance, new ways to add friends and experience and chips rewards.

You can see the details at our Discord: https://discord.gg/T5eCRSw

Or you can just jump right into the game !


Thanks, see you playing ManaRocks!
ManaRocks Team

notes.title: New Story Mode and Next Season Changes
notes.content:
Our new season is approaching and we want to explain some news and changes that will happen in addition to new cards and habilities.

The first change is that all players will start with much more cards available. All basic and common from the previous season will be available from the start and it will be much faster, and fun, to release rare, legendary and mythical cards.

On the second season we will have a Story Mode that initially will have three chapters: Heroes, Myths and Mana Shards.

When you defeat each Story Mode Challenge you will unlock some cards and receive your opponent's deck.

The first challenges will be in the first chapter: Heroes, where you must defeat each one of the six heroes to release all the rare cards and decks from them.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31411040/75dbcbd2e4c6ee40295877e25e440b083c152d16.png[/img]


After this first chapter you will open two more:

- Myths, where you will face Mythical Heroes to release all Legendary and Mythic cards of each color.

- Mana Shards, you'll face the heroes of the new season and release the new cards. Challenges in this mode will take a break and will be made available on specific dates.


With these changes the rewards for Level Up and Mana Pass will only focus on Cosmetics, Coins, Bonuses and some other new things to come.

Thus, only matches in Play Mode will give XP. You can still complete Daily and Weekly Missions in Practice Mode.

Stay tuned, at the end of this week we will announce the first card from Mana Shards Season and changes in the old collection.

We hope you like the changes, your comments and thoughts are welcome in our Discord: https://discord.gg/T5eCRSw

See you playing ManaRocks!

notes.title: Patch Notes 2019.03.25
notes.content:
In this update we are improving our main progressions systems, meaning Level and Tier.

We tried to hear every comment that you've made. Of course, there is a lot to be done yet, and we count on you to keep helping us improve ManaRocks.

Here are the changes:

[b]New Tiers.[/b]

We created more Tiers and changed a bit our MMR System, that way we expect that players face opponents with the same skill level.

Now we have 11 Tiers, and the Tier Points required to achieve each one has changed.

Next time you login you may be at a different Tier, higher or lower, depending of how much TP you have.

[b]Experience Points (XP) [/b]

We re-designed our Level curve and Xp Gain, now you will evolve and unlock cards much faster.

ATTENTION: When you login next time your level will be updated and you will receive the rewards. There will be NO pop-ups to show that :(

Play Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 60 XP, Defeat: 30.
2v2 matchs (after 10 turns): Victory 120 XP, Defeat: 60.

Practice Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 30 XP, Defeat: 15.
2v2 matchs with 3 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 30 XP, Defeat: 15.
2v2 matchs with 2 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 60 XP, Defeat: 30.


[b]Mulligan and Playing Second Balance[/b]

Now the second player will start with the 5th card already in hand, meaning he will know he is second and having an advantage of mulligan an extra card.


[b]Card Text Searching[/b]

Now you can search for card texts, titles, effects and habilities at Deck Editing screen. Right now you can only seacrh for complete words.


[b]Tutorial[/b]

We have fixed many Tutorial problems and added an optional Practice Step.


[b]New Languages[/b]

Now you can play ManaRocks in Russian and German.

notes.title: Patch Notes 2019.03.15
notes.content:
Hello, this is our first Patch after the Early Access release. 

We tried to hear every comment that you've made. Of course, there is a lot to be done yet, and we count on you to keep helping us improve ManaRocks.

On this update we tried to focus on things that were bothering the most of players: Tutorial, MatchMaking and Animations.

Here are the changes:

[b]Matchmaking are now based on Tiers.[/b]

The server will try to find an opponent that fit the best of your skills. One side effect is it may take a little bit longer to find an opponent as you are higher on ladder.


[b]2v2 Matchmaking Bug. [/b]

Now if you join a friend you will enter any room already created.


[b]Experience Points (XP) [/b]

Play Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 30 XP, Defeat: 15.
2v2 matchs (after 10 turns): Victory 50 XP, Defeat: 25.

Practice Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 20 XP, Defeat: 10.
2v2 matchs with 3 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 20 XP, Defeat: 10.
2v2 matchs with 2 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 30 XP, Defeat: 15.


[b]Tier Up and Tier Points[/b]

The way you receive Tier Points has changed. Now it will vary if you face an opponent from a different Tier.

If you defeat an opponent from a higher Tier you will earn 25% more Tiers Points for each Tier above yours. If you lose you will lose 25% less for each Tier, 75% max.

If you defeat an opponent from a lower Tier you will receive 25% less Tier Points for each tier bellow, 75% max. If you lose you will lose 25% less for each Tier, 75% max.


[b]Animations[/b]

We accelerate some problematic animations, like card draw and buffs. Now matches run much faster than before.


[b]VSync [/b]

Now VSync is on.


[b]Tutorial[/b]

Now players will see better explanations of what they should do, specially if they did something not expected.


[b]Spelling Errors[/b]

[b]Experience Points (XP) [/b]

Play Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 30 XP, Defeat: 15.
2v2 matchs (after 10 turns): Victory 50 XP, Defeat: 25.

Practice Mode:

1v1 matches (after 10 turns): Victory: 20 XP, Defeat: 10.
2v2 matchs with 3 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 20 XP, Defeat: 10.
2v2 matchs with 2 Bots (after 10 turns): Victory 30 XP, Defeat: 15.

[b]Tier Up and Tier Points[/b]

The way you receive Tier Points has changed. Now it will vary if you face an opponent from a different Tier.

If you defeat an opponent from a higher Tier you will earn 25% more Tiers Points for each Tier above yours. If you lose you will lose 25% less for each Tier, 75% max.

If you defeat an opponent from a lower Tier you will receive 25% less Tier Points for each tier bellow, 75% max. If you lose you will lose 25% less for each Tier, 75% max.
